ideas.name: Natural Gas Storage Announcement Day
ideas.claim: Natural gas futures had a lower mean daily return on EIA storage announcement days than on other days.
ideas.quote: For the first nearby contract, the mean daily return on EIA announcement days is −0.37%, while it is only −0.09% on the remaining days.

rules.market: Henry Hub natural gas futures, first nearby contract
rules.filters: Exclude days when the natural gas storage report coincides with the EIA petroleum report.

ideas.claimed_result: Mean daily return was −0.37% on announcement days versus −0.09% on other days; the paper reports a statistically significant difference at the 5% level.
